newsitem.title: GERMANY: Conti says EU clears Michelin venture.
newsitem.headline: Conti says EU clears Michelin venture.

text.p: German tyre maker Continental AG said on Monday that the European Commission had cleared its planned venture with French tyre group Michelin.

"The European Commission in Brussels in an administrative letter said it has concluded its examination of the planned cooperation with Michelin in tyres and sees no reason to block it," Conti said in a statement.
The Commission said last August that it expected to clear the joint venture after seeking comment from interested parties.
The two companies have proposed creating a company in which each will hold a 50 percent share, with Michelin contributing the rights to the Uniroyal tyre trademark in Europe.

Continental will contribute an effective controlling interest in its production facilities for low-cost tyres in Barum, Czech Rebpulic. It will also contribute a 25 percent interest in the basic capital of Vergoelst GmbH, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary.
